title: Error "cannot read property query of undefined" Angular-instant search V2.2.2 + Algoliasearch 3.30.0
body:
Trying to implement this sandbox [https://codesandbox.io/s/angular-instantsearch-app-4n4yv](url) to prevent search on an empty query using Angular Instant Search v2.2.2 + Algoliasearch 3.30.0 but I'm getting this error. The error occurs as soon as I open the component that uses the angular instant sarch. Please can you help?
